Subject: Discovery recap & next steps - Redwood + Acme Corp

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for taking the time today - really enjoyed learning more about Acme's plans for scaling search and chat across customer support. Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

What we heard:
- Main goal: reduce average time-to-resolution on support queries by surfacing AI-driven answers inside the agent console (target 30% improvement).
- Traffic profile: ~1200 concurrent daily sessions, spiky during EMEA morning.
- Constraints: data residency requirement for EU-sourced tickets; encrypted at rest; we need audit logs.

How Redwood can help (short):
- Dedicated deployment option (VPC) for data isolation + KMS support.
- Model routing: lower-cost embeddings for retrieval + p99 latency targets under 250ms for common paths.
- Observability and rollouts: per-route metrics and canary deploy options to manage quality regressions.

Proposed next steps:
1) Marissa to share product one-pager and example architecture (attached).
2) If this looks like a fit, schedule a 30-min technical sync with your infra lead (I can loop in our solutions engineer).
3) I’ll also share an estimate for cost and a sample Mutual Action Plan for procurement.

Attachment: redwood-product-overview.pdf (12 KB, PDF)

Can you confirm if the next best person to include for the technical sync is your infra lead or the platform lead? I’m available Wed/Thu this week between 10-2 PT.

Thanks,
Marissa
